1	# AGENTS.md
2	
3	This file provides guidance to ANY AGENTS when working with code in this repository.
4	
5	## Project
6	
7	AutoRound — post-training quantization for LLMs/VLMs using sign-gradient descent. Publishes as `auto-round` (GPU/CPU) and `auto-round-hpu` (Intel Gaudi).
8	
9	## Build & Install
10	
11	```bash
12	# From source (GPU/CPU) — --no-build-isolation is required when PyTorch is already installed
13	pip install --no-build-isolation -e .
14	
15	# HPU variant
16	BUILD_HPU_ONLY=1 pip install --no-build-isolation .
17	# or: python setup.py hpu install
18	
19	# XPU variant — install Intel PyTorch first
20	pip install torch --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/xpu
21	pip install --no-build-isolation .
22	```
23	
24	## Testing
25	
26	Tests are split into three tiers under `test/`: `unit/` (fast, runs in PR CI),
27	`integration/` (third-party frameworks, runs nightly), and `e2e/` (full models /
28	real inference engines, runs weekly). Each tier is further split by hardware
29	(`test_cpu/`, `test_cuda/`, `test_hpu/`, `test_xpu/`, `test_ark/`, `test_mlx/`).
30	
31	```bash
32	# CPU unit tests (most common during development)
33	pytest test/unit/test_cpu/ -x -q
34	
35	# Single test
36	pytest test/unit/test_cpu/ -k "test_name" -x -q
37	
38	# Hardware-specific unit tests
39	pytest test/unit/test_cuda/
40	pytest test/unit/test_hpu/ --mode=lazy   # or --mode=compile
41	pytest test/unit/test_xpu/
42	
43	# Slower suites (nightly / weekly)
44	pytest test/integration/test_cpu/
45	pytest test/e2e/test_cpu/
46	```
47	
48	Test fixtures create tiny models (OPT-125M, Qwen-0.6B) at session scope — first run downloads them.
49	
50	## Code Style
51	
52	- **Line length: 120** (non-default) — enforced by black, isort, ruff, pylint
53	- **Formatter: black** (profile used by isort)
54	- **Import sorting: isort** with `profile=black`, first-party: `auto_round`, `auto_round_extension`
55	- **Linter: ruff** — rules `E4, E7, E9, F, NPY, FURB`; E501/E402/F401/F403 are intentionally ignored
56	- **License header**: Apache 2.0 auto-inserted into `.py/.yaml/.yml/.sh` under `auto_round/` and `auto_round_extension/`
57	- Pre-commit config: `.pre-commit-config.yaml`
58	
59	## Commit & PR Conventions
60	
61	- Conventional commits: `feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, `docs:`, `refactor:`, `test:`
62	- PRs target `main`, squash-merged
63	- **CN docs rule**: any change to a `.md` file must include a matching update to its `_CN` counterpart (e.g., `README.md` → `README_CN.md`)
64	
65	## Key Environment Variables
66	
67	- `BUILD_HPU_ONLY=1` — build HPU package variant
68	- `AR_USE_MODELSCOPE=1` — use ModelScope instead of HuggingFace for model downloads
69	- `FORCE_BF16=1` — force BF16 in tests (used in CI)
70	
71	## Source Layout
72	
73	- `auto_round/` — core library (AutoRound class, sign-SGD, exporters, eval, data types)
74	- `auto_round_extension/` — hardware backends (CUDA, HPU, IPEX/XPU, Triton, ARK, vLLM)
75	- `test/` — tests organized by tier then hardware: `unit/` (PR CI), `integration/` (nightly), `e2e/` (weekly), each with `test_cpu/`, `test_cuda/`, ...
76	- `examples/` — usage examples for different model types

82	- Some test dependencies (AutoAWQ, GPTQModel, llama-cpp) require manual git installs — see comments in `test/unit/test_cuda/requirements.txt`

117	    """Return the compressor class for *base_cls* wired with the right model-type Mixin.

119	    For ``model_type == "llm"`` the bare *base_cls* is returned unchanged.
120	    For ``"mllm"`` and ``"diffusion"`` the corresponding Mixin is prepended via
121	    :func:`type` and the result is cached in ``_COMPRESSOR_REGISTRY`` so that
122	    each ``(model_type, base_cls)`` pair is created at most once per process.
123	    """
124	    if model_type == "llm":
125	        return base_cls

127	    if key in _COMPRESSOR_REGISTRY:
128	        return _COMPRESSOR_REGISTRY[key]

1	# AutoRound for Diffusion Models (Experimental)
2	
3	This feature is experimental and may be subject to changes, including potential bug fixes, API modifications, or adjustments to default parameters.
4	
5	AutoRound uses the new compressor and calibration architecture for diffusion quantization. Diffusion models are routed by `auto_round/compressors/entry.py`, diffusion-specific compressor behavior lives in `auto_round/compressors/diffusion_mixin.py`, and calibration is handled by `auto_round/calibration/diffusion.py`.
6	
7	## Quantization
8	
9	Quantization for diffusion models is limited:
10	
11	1. Only the transformer module of diffusion models is quantized.
12	2. Loading quantized diffusion models is not supported yet, so use `fake` format for quantization.
13	3. Calibration dataset currently supports `coco2014` and user customized `.tsv` files.
14	
15	### API Usage (CPU/GPU) Recommended
16	
17	```python
18	import torch
19	from auto_round import AutoRound
20	
21	# Quantize the model
22	autoround = AutoRound(
23	    "black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-dev",
24	    scheme="MXFP8",
25	    dataset="coco2014",
26	    num_inference_steps=10,
27	    guidance_scale=7.5,
28	    generator_seed=None,
29	    batch_size=1,
30	)
31	
32	# Save the quantized model
33	output_dir = "./tmp_autoround"
34	# Loading quantized diffusion models is not supported yet, so use fake format.
35	autoround.quantize_and_save(output_dir, format="fake", inplace=True)
36	```
37	
38	- `dataset`: the dataset for quantization training. Currently supports `coco2014` and user customized `.tsv` files.
39	- `num_inference_steps`: the reference number of denoising steps.
40	- `guidance_scale`: controls how much the image generation process follows the text prompt.
41	- `generator_seed`: a seed that controls the initial noise from which an image is generated.
42	
43	For more hyperparameters, refer to [Homepage Detailed Hyperparameters](../../../README.md#quantization-scheme--configuration).
44	
45	### CLI Usage
46	
47	A user guide detailing the full list of supported arguments is provided by calling `auto-round -h` on the terminal.
48	
49	```bash
50	auto-round \
51	    --model black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-dev \
52	    --scheme MXFP8 \
53	    --format fake \
54	    --batch_size 1 \
55	    --dataset coco2014 \
56	    --output_dir ./tmp_autoround
57	```
58	
59	### Diffusion Support Matrix
60	
61	For diffusion models, currently we validate quantization on the following models, which involves quantizing the transformer component of the pipeline.
62	
63	| Model         | calibration dataset |  Model Link  |
64	|---------------|---------------------|--------------|
65	| black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-dev  | COCO2014      | - |
66	| Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image            | COCO2014      | - |
67	| Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image-Turb       | COCO2014      | - |
68	| stepfun-ai/NextStep-1.1       | COCO2014      | - |
69	| AIDC-AI/Ovis-Image-7B         | COCO2014      | - |
70	| stabilityai/stable-audio-open-1.0 | audiocaps | - |
71	| Wan-AI/Wan2.2-I2V-A14B-Diffusers | COCO2014   | - |
72	| Wan-AI/Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-Diffusers  | COCO2014   | - |
73	| Wan-AI/Wan2.2-T2V-A14B-Diffusers | COCO2014   | - |
74	| nvidia/Cosmos3-Nano              | COCO2014   | - |
75	| nvidia/Cosmos3-Super             | COCO2014   | - |
76	
77	<details>
78	<summary style="font-size:17px;">Calibration Dataset</summary>
79	
80	For diffusion models, we use [**coco2014**](https://github.com/mlcommons/inference/raw/refs/heads/master/text_to_image/coco2014/captions/captions_source.tsv) calibration dataset as the default.
81	
82	To use a custom dataset, build a `.tsv` file with the following structure and pass it through `--dataset`:
83	
84	```text
85	id      caption
86	0       YOUR_PROMPT
87	1       YOUR_PROMPT
88	...     ...
89	```
90	
91	- `id`: the id used to map generated images and prompts.
92	- `caption`: the text prompt used to generate the images.
93	
94	</details>

33	class DiffusionMixin:
34	    """Diffusion-specific functionality mixin.
35	
36	    This mixin adds diffusion model-specific functionality to any compressor
37	    (Compressor, ImatrixCompressor, etc). It handles
38	    diffusion models (like Stable Diffusion, FLUX) that require special pipeline
39	    handling and data generation logic.
40	
41	    Can be combined with:
42	    - Compressor (for AutoRound with calibration, or basic RTN)
43	    - ImatrixCompressor (for RTN with importance matrix)
44	
45	    Diffusion-specific parameters:
46	        guidance_scale: Control how much image generation follows text prompt
47	        num_inference_steps: Reference number of denoising steps
48	        generator_seed: Seed for initial noise generation
49	
50	    Design note:
51	        ``ModelContext._load_model()`` loads the diffusion pipeline and sets
52	        ``model_context.pipe`` and ``model_context.model`` (the unet/transformer).
53	        This mixin reads ``self.model_context.pipe`` directly during calibration and
54	        saving so that ``model_context`` remains the single source of truth.
55	    """
56	
57	    def __init__(
58	        self,
59	        *args,
60	        guidance_scale: float = 7.5,
61	        num_inference_steps: int = 50,
62	        generator_seed: Optional[int] = None,
63	        **kwargs,
64	    ) -> None:
65	        # Store diffusion-specific attributes
66	        self.guidance_scale = guidance_scale
67	        self.num_inference_steps = num_inference_steps
68	        self.generator_seed = generator_seed
69	        self.pipeline_call_kwargs = dict(kwargs.pop("pipeline_call_kwargs", {}) or {})
70	
71	        # Default dataset for diffusion models is "coco2014", not "NeelNanda/pile-10k"
72	        if kwargs.get("dataset") in (None, "NeelNanda/pile-10k"):
73	            kwargs["dataset"] = "coco2014"
74	
75	        iters = kwargs.get("iters", None)
76	        _alg_cfg = args[0] if args else None
77	        if iters is None and _alg_cfg is not None:
78	            cfgs = _alg_cfg if isinstance(_alg_cfg, list) else [_alg_cfg]
79	            for cfg in cfgs:
80	                if hasattr(cfg, "iters") and cfg.iters is not None:
81	                    iters = cfg.iters
82	                    break
83	        if iters is None:
84	            iters = 200
85	
86	        if iters > 0:
87	            # ``batch_size`` is owned by the compressor / shared
88	            # CalibrationContext; it only comes from kwargs now (entry.py forwards
89	            # it explicitly).  AlgConfig no longer carries it.  Treat a missing
90	            # value as ``BaseCompressor``'s default (8) so the reset path always
91	            # triggers when the user didn't explicitly opt out.
92	            batch_size = kwargs.get("batch_size", 8)
93	            if batch_size != 1:
94	                grad_acc = kwargs.get("gradient_accumulate_steps", 1)
95	                if _alg_cfg is not None:
96	                    cfgs = _alg_cfg if isinstance(_alg_cfg, list) else [_alg_cfg]
97	                    for cfg in cfgs:
98	                        if hasattr(cfg, "gradient_accumulate_steps") and cfg.gradient_accumulate_steps is not None:
99	                            grad_acc = cfg.gradient_accumulate_steps
100	                            break
101	                new_grad_acc = batch_size * grad_acc
102	                kwargs["gradient_accumulate_steps"] = new_grad_acc
103	                kwargs["batch_size"] = 1
104	                if _alg_cfg is not None:
105	                    cfgs = _alg_cfg if isinstance(_alg_cfg, list) else [_alg_cfg]
106	                    for cfg in cfgs:
107	                        if hasattr(cfg, "gradient_accumulate_steps"):
108	                            cfg.gradient_accumulate_steps = new_grad_acc
109	                logger.warning(
110	                    f"reset batch_size({batch_size}) to 1 and "
111	                    f"gradient_accumulate_steps to {new_grad_acc} "
112	                    f"because batch_size={batch_size} cannot be used for calibrating non-text modules."
113	                )
114	
115	        # Call parent class __init__ (will be Compressor, ImatrixCompressor, etc)
116	        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
117	
118	        pipe = getattr(self.model_context, "pipe", None)
119	        model = getattr(self.model_context, "model", None)
120	        if pipe is not None and model is not None:
121	            is_nextstep = hasattr(model, "config") and getattr(model.config, "model_type", None) == "nextstep"
122	            if not is_nextstep:
123	                self._align_pipeline_dtype(pipe, model.dtype)
124	
125	    @staticmethod
126	    def _align_pipeline_dtype(pipe, target_dtype) -> None:
127	        """Align ordinary components while preserving declared FP32 modules."""
128	        for component_name in pipe.components:
129	            component = getattr(pipe, component_name, None)
130	            if (
131	                not isinstance(component, torch.nn.Module)
132	                or not hasattr(component, "dtype")
133	                or component.dtype == target_dtype
134	            ):
135	                continue
136	            if getattr(component, "_keep_in_fp32_modules", None):
137	                continue
138	            component.to(dtype=target_dtype)
139	
140	    def _get_calibrator_kind(self) -> str:
141	        """Select the diffusion calibration strategy.
142	
143	        ``DiffusionCalibrator`` lives at
144	        :mod:`auto_round.calibration.diffusion` and owns what used to be
145	        ``DiffusionMixin.calib`` / ``_get_block_forward_func`` /
146	        ``_should_stop_cache_forward``.
147	        """
148	        return "diffusion"
149	
150	    def _find_additional_transformers(self):
151	        """Find transformer components beyond the primary one (e.g. transformer_2 in WAN)."""
152	        pipe = getattr(self.model_context, "pipe", None)
153	        if pipe is None:
154	            return []
155	        result = []
156	        for comp_name in pipe.components:
157	            comp = getattr(pipe, comp_name, None)
158	            if (
159	                comp_name.startswith("transformer")
160	                and comp_name != "transformer"
161	                and comp is not None
162	                and isinstance(comp, torch.nn.Module)
163	            ):
164	                result.append((comp_name, comp))
165	        return result
166	
167	    def _align_device_and_dtype_for_secondary(self, transformer_name: str):
168	        """Align safe component dtypes and dispatch a secondary transformer."""
169	        pipe = getattr(self.model_context, "pipe", None)
170	        model = getattr(self.model_context, "model", None)
171	        if pipe is None or model is None:
172	            return
173	
174	        is_nextstep = hasattr(model, "config") and getattr(model.config, "model_type", None) == "nextstep"
175	        if not is_nextstep:
176	            self._align_pipeline_dtype(pipe, model.dtype)
177	
178	        # Dispatch secondary transformer to GPU(s)
179	        device_map = getattr(self.compress_context, "device_map", None)
180	        device_list = getattr(self.compress_context, "device_list", [])
181	        multi_device = is_auto_device_mapping(device_map) and len(device_list) > 1
182	
183	        if multi_device:
184	            comp_device = device_list[-1]
185	            for comp_name in pipe.components:
186	                comp = getattr(pipe, comp_name, None)
187	                if comp is None or comp is model or not hasattr(comp, "to"):
188	                    continue
189	                is_other_transformer = (
190	                    comp_name.startswith("transformer")
191	                    and isinstance(comp, torch.nn.Module)
192	                    and next(comp.parameters()).device.type == "cpu"
193	                )
194	                is_other_component = not comp_name.startswith("transformer")
195	                if is_other_transformer or is_other_component:
196	                    try:
197	                        comp.to(comp_device)
198	                    except (NotImplementedError, RuntimeError):
199	                        continue
200	
201	            self.model_context.model = dispatch_model_block_wise(model, device_map)
202	            setattr(pipe, transformer_name, self.model_context.model)
203	        elif device_map is not None:
204	            target_device = get_major_device(device_map)
205	            pipe.to(target_device)

207	    @torch.no_grad()
208	    def calib(self, nsamples: int, bs: int) -> None:
209	        """Perform diffusion-specific calibration for quantization.
210	
211	        Override parent's calib method to use diffusion dataset loading logic.
212	        The diffusion pipeline is read from ``self.model_context.pipe``.
213	        """
214	        from auto_round.compressors.diffusion.dataset import get_diffusion_dataloader
215	
216	        pipe = self.model_context.pipe
217	        if pipe is None:
218	            raise ValueError(
219	                "Diffusion pipeline not found in model_context. " "Ensure the model was loaded as a diffusion model."
220	            )
221	
222	        logger.warning(
223	            "Diffusion model will catch nsamples * num_inference_steps inputs, "
224	            "you can reduce nsamples or num_inference_steps if OOM or take too much time."
225	        )
226	        if isinstance(self.dataset, str):
227	            dataset = self.dataset.replace(" ", "")
228	            self.dataloader, self.batch_size = get_diffusion_dataloader(
229	                dataset=dataset,
230	                bs=self.batch_size,
231	                seed=self.seed,
232	                nsamples=self.calibration_context.nsamples,
233	            )
234	        else:
235	            self.dataloader = self.dataset
236	        total_cnt = 0
237	
238	        total = nsamples if not hasattr(self.dataloader, "len") else min(nsamples, len(self.dataloader))
239	
240	        # NOTE: we intentionally skip the sequential offloading check here (the guard that
241	        # exits when pipe is already dispatched).  In new-arch diffusion, the pipe may
242	        # already be dispatched to multi-device in a prior calib call.  The dispatch
243	        # state is preserved across calls, so re-dispatching or moving is unnecessary and
244	        # would break the existing placement.
245	        if pipe.device != self.model.device:
246	            pipe.to(self.model.device)
247	        if (
248	            hasattr(self.model, "hf_device_map")
249	            and len(self.model.hf_device_map) > 1
250	            and torch.device(self.model.device).type in ["cuda", "xpu"]
251	        ):
252	            logger.warning(
253	                "Diffusion model is activated sequential model offloading. "
254	                "Pipe may already be dispatched from a prior calib call. "
255	                "Skipping re-dispatch to avoid breaking the existing placement."
256	            )
257	
258	        device_map = getattr(self.compress_context, "device_map", None)
259	        device_list = getattr(self.compress_context, "device_list", [])
260	        # Skip dispatch for secondary transformers
261	        if (
262	            not getattr(self, "_inputs_cached", False)
263	            and device_map is not None
264	            and is_auto_device_mapping(device_map)
265	            and len(device_list) > 1
266	        ):
267	            pipe_transformer = getattr(pipe, "transformer", None)
268	            if self.model_context.model is not pipe_transformer:
269	                pass  # secondary transformer — skip pipeline dispatch
270	            else:
271	                pipe = dispatch_model_by_all_available_devices(pipe, device_map)
272	
273	        with tqdm(range(1, total + 1), desc="cache block inputs") as pbar:
274	            for ids, prompts in self.dataloader:
275	                if isinstance(prompts, tuple):
276	                    prompts = list(prompts)
277	                pipe_kwargs = self._build_pipeline_call_kwargs(pipe, prompts)
278	                try:
279	                    if self._requires_calibration_image() or "prompt" in pipe_kwargs:
280	                        # I2V pipeline: 'image' is the first positional arg, so pass
281	                        # 'prompt' as keyword to avoid "multiple values for argument 'image'".
282	                        pipe(**pipe_kwargs)
283	                    else:
284	                        pipe(prompts, **pipe_kwargs)
285	                except NotImplementedError:
286	                    pass
287	                except Exception as error:
288	                    raise error
289	                step = len(prompts)
290	                total_cnt += step
291	                pbar.update(step)
292	                if total_cnt >= nsamples:
293	                    break
294	        if total_cnt == 0:
295	            logger.error(
296	                f"no data has been cached, please provide more data with sequence length >={self.seqlen} in the "
297	                f"dataset or decease the sequence length"
298	            )
299	            exit(-1)
300	        elif total_cnt < nsamples:
301	            logger.warning(
302	                f"Insufficient number of samples collected may affect the quantization. "
303	                f"target samples count is {nsamples}, while valid samples count is {total_cnt}"
304	            )
305	            if total_cnt < self.batch_size:
306	                raise ValueError(
307	                    f"valid samples is less than batch_size({self.batch_size}),"
308	                    " please adjust self.batch_size or seqlen."
309	                )
310	            max_len = (total_cnt // self.batch_size) * self.batch_size
311	            for k, v in self.inputs.items():
312	                for key in v:
313	                    if isinstance(v[key], list) and len(v[key]) == total_cnt:
314	                        self.inputs[k][key] = v[key][:max_len]

319	    def try_cache_inter_data_gpucpu(self, *args, **kwargs) -> Any:
320	        """Skip re-caching when DiffusionMixin.quantize has already populated self.inputs.
321	
322	        CalibCompressor.quantize() always calls try_cache_inter_data_gpucpu, but for
323	        diffusion models the inputs were already collected by the diffusion pipeline
324	        in DiffusionMixin.quantize().  Return the cached data directly.
325	        """
326	        if getattr(self, "_inputs_cached", False):
327	            self._inputs_cached = False
328	            return self.inputs
329	        if hasattr(super(), "try_cache_inter_data_gpucpu"):
330	            return super().try_cache_inter_data_gpucpu(*args, **kwargs)
331	
332	    def quantize(self) -> tuple[torch.nn.Module, dict]:
333	        """Quantize the diffusion model.
334	
335	        Overrides the parent to use diffusion-specific cache_inter_data instead of
336	        the LLM-specific calib path.  The diffusion pipeline forward is used to collect
337	        block inputs (via _replace_forward hooks), then those inputs are passed to the
338	        standard CalibCompressor quantization loop.
339	
340	        For dual-transformer pipelines (e.g. WAN with transformer + transformer_2),
341	        this method quantizes all transformers sequentially.
342	        """
343	        from auto_round.utils import find_matching_blocks, get_block_names
344	        from auto_round.utils.common import flatten_list
345	
346	        self.post_init()
347	
348	        # Zero-shot (RTN) path: no calibration data needed
349	        if not self.need_calib:
350	            return self._quantize_zero_shot()
351	
352	        # Get block names and call cache_inter_data to populate self.inputs
353	        if bool(self.quant_block_list):
354	            all_blocks = self.quant_block_list
355	        else:
356	            all_blocks = get_block_names(self.model_context.model)
357	        if len(all_blocks) == 0:
358	            logger.warning("could not find blocks, exit with original model")
359	            return self.model, self.layer_config
360	
361	        if not self.has_variable_block_shape:
362	            to_cache_block_names = [block[0] for block in all_blocks]
363	        else:
364	            to_cache_block_names = flatten_list(all_blocks)
365	
366	        # Check for additional transformers (e.g. transformer_2 in WAN)
367	        additional = self._find_additional_transformers()
368	        if not additional:
369	            # Single-transformer path: let calib() own pipeline dispatch.
370	            pipe = self.model_context.pipe
371	            device_map = getattr(self.compress_context, "device_map", None)
372	            if device_map is not None and not is_auto_device_mapping(device_map) and not isinstance(device_map, int):
373	                target_device = get_major_device(device_map)
374	                # Skip if the transformer is already on the target device to avoid
375	                # redundant full-model transfer that exhausts GPU memory.
376	                transformer = getattr(pipe, "transformer", None) or getattr(pipe, "unet", None)
377	                param = next(transformer.parameters(), None) if transformer else None
378	                skip_move = param is not None and get_major_device(str(param.device)) == target_device
379	                if not skip_move:
380	                    pipe.to(target_device)
381	
382	            logger.info("start to cache block inputs")
383	            all_inputs = self.try_cache_inter_data_gpucpu(
384	                to_cache_block_names,
385	                self.calibration_context.nsamples,
386	                layer_names=[],
387	            )
388	            self.inputs = all_inputs
389	            if getattr(self.calibration, "_cpu_offload_mode", None) == "model":
390	                from accelerate.hooks import remove_hook_from_submodules
391	
392	                remove_hook_from_submodules(self.model_context.model)
393	            clear_memory()
394	            self._inputs_cached = True
395	            return super().quantize()
396	
397	        # Dual-transformer path: quantize all transformers sequentially
398	        logger.info("Detected multi-transformer diffusion pipeline, quantizing all transformers")
399	
400	        # Ensure at least 2 inference steps so both transformers are exercised during calibration
401	        orig_steps = getattr(self, "num_inference_steps", None) or 50
402	        if orig_steps < 2:
403	            logger.warning(
404	                f"num_inference_steps={orig_steps} is too low for dual-transformer "
405	                f"quantization — increasing to 2 so all transformers receive calibration data."
406	            )
407	            self.num_inference_steps = 2
408	
409	        # Disable low_cpu_mem_usage so quantized models stay in memory during multi-transformer
410	        # quantization.
411	        orig_low_cpu = self.compress_context.low_cpu_mem_usage
412	        orig_immediate_saving = self.compress_context.is_immediate_saving
413	        self.compress_context.low_cpu_mem_usage = False
414	        # Defer shard writing until all transformers are quantized. Immediate saving
415	        # offloads the primary transformer to meta during the first pass, which breaks
416	        # later calibration when the pipeline switches to transformer_2.
417	        self.compress_context.is_immediate_saving = False
418	
419	        # Store primary transformer state
420	        primary_model = self.model
421	        primary_layer_config = dict(self.layer_config) if self.layer_config else {}
422	        primary_quant_block_list = list(self.quant_block_list) if self.quant_block_list else []
423	        quantized_extras = {}
424	
425	        # Quantize primary transformer
426	        logger.info("start to cache block inputs for primary transformer")
427	        all_inputs = self.try_cache_inter_data_gpucpu(
428	            to_cache_block_names,
429	            self.calibration_context.nsamples,
430	            layer_names=[],
431	        )
432	        self.inputs = all_inputs
433	        clear_memory(device_list=device_manager.device_list)
434	        self._inputs_cached = True
435	        super().quantize()
436	
437	        # Clear stale hf_device_map so cache_inter_data can re-dispatch for next transformer
438	        if hasattr(primary_model, "hf_device_map"):
439	            delattr(primary_model, "hf_device_map")
440	
441	        # Quantize additional transformers
442	        for comp_name, transformer in additional:
443	            logger.info(f"Quantizing {comp_name}")
444	
445	            # Reset quantization state for new transformer
446	            self.model_context.model = transformer
447	            self.model_context.quantized = False
448	            self._post_init_done = False
449	
450	            # Dispatch the pipeline for the secondary transformer without recasting it.
451	            self._align_device_and_dtype_for_secondary(comp_name)
452	
453	            # Re-run post_init to set up quantizer for new model
454	            self.post_init()
455	
456	            # Get block names for new transformer
457	            all_blocks = get_block_names(self.model_context.model)
458	            self.quant_block_list = find_matching_blocks(self.model_context.model, all_blocks, None)
459	            self.layer_config = {}
460	
461	            # Get new block names for caching
462	            if bool(self.quantizer.quant_block_list):
463	                all_blocks = self.quantizer.quant_block_list
464	            else:
465	                all_blocks = get_block_names(self.model_context.model)
466	            if len(all_blocks) == 0:
467	                logger.warning(f"could not find blocks in {comp_name}, skipping")
468	                continue
469	
470	            if not self.has_variable_block_shape:
471	                to_cache_block_names = [block[0] for block in all_blocks]
472	            else:
473	                to_cache_block_names = flatten_list(all_blocks)
474	
475	            logger.info(f"start to cache block inputs for {comp_name}")
476	            all_inputs = self.try_cache_inter_data_gpucpu(
477	                to_cache_block_names,
478	                self.calibration_context.nsamples,
479	                layer_names=[],
480	            )
481	            self.inputs = all_inputs
482	            clear_memory(device_list=device_manager.device_list)
483	            self._inputs_cached = True
484	            super().quantize()
485	
486	            # Store quantized transformer
487	            quantized_extras[comp_name] = (self.model_context.model, dict(self.layer_config))
488	            # Also update the pipeline to reference the quantized transformer
489	            setattr(self.model_context.pipe, comp_name, self.model_context.model)
490	
491	        # Restore primary transformer state
492	        self.model_context.model = primary_model
493	        self.model_context.quantized = True
494	        self.layer_config = primary_layer_config
495	        self.quant_block_list = primary_quant_block_list
496	        self._quantized_transformers = quantized_extras
497	        self.compress_context.low_cpu_mem_usage = orig_low_cpu
498	        self.compress_context.is_immediate_saving = orig_immediate_saving
499	        self.num_inference_steps = orig_steps
500	
501	        return self.model_context.model, self.quantizer.layer_config

503	    def save_quantized(
504	        self,
505	        output_dir: Optional[str] = None,
506	        format: Optional[Union[str, list]] = None,
507	        inplace: bool = True,
508	        return_folders: bool = False,

512	
513	        For multi-transformer pipelines, all quantized transformers are saved.
514	
515	        Args:
516	            output_dir (str, optional): The directory to save the quantized model. Defaults to None.
517	            format (str, optional): The format in which to save the model. Defaults to "auto_round".
518	            inplace (bool, optional): Whether to modify the model in place. Defaults to True.
519	            return_folders (bool, optional): Whether to return the save folder paths. Defaults to False.
520	            **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments specific to the export format.
521	
522	        Returns:
523	            object: The compressed model object, or (compressed_model, folders) if return_folders is True.
524	        """

527	                output_dir, format=format, inplace=inplace, return_folders=return_folders, **kwargs
528	            )
529	
530	        pipe = self.model_context.pipe
531	        quantized_transformers = getattr(self, "_quantized_transformers", {})
532	        compressed_model = None
533	        folders = []
534	        has_multiple_quantized_transformers = bool(quantized_transformers)
535	
536	        # Handle multi-format (convert string to list if needed)

538	        if isinstance(_format, str):

30	def compute_clip(prompts, images, device: str = "cuda"):
31	    clip_model = metrics.CLIPScore(model_name_or_path="openai/clip-vit-large-patch14").to(device)
32	    for prompt, img_path in tqdm(zip(prompts, images), desc="Computing CLIP score"):
33	        image_data = Image.open(img_path).convert("RGB")
34	        image_tensor = torch.from_numpy(np.array(image_data)).permute(2, 0, 1)
35	        clip_model.update(image_tensor.to(torch.float32).to(device).unsqueeze(0), prompt)
36	    result = clip_model.compute().mean().item()
37	    return {"CLIP": result}

42	    for prompt, img_path in tqdm(zip(prompts, images), desc="Computing CLIP-IQA score"):

50	def compute_image_reward_metrics(prompts, images, device="cuda"):
51	    image_reward_model = reward.load("ImageReward-v1.0", device=device)

38	def _prepare_pipeline_for_calibration(pipe, target_device, *, low_gpu_mem_usage: bool) -> str | None:
39	    """Place a diffusion pipeline for calibration without exceeding one GPU."""
40	    resolved_device = torch.device(target_device)
41	    if low_gpu_mem_usage:
42	        enable_model_cpu_offload = getattr(pipe, "enable_model_cpu_offload", None)
43	        if not callable(enable_model_cpu_offload):
44	            raise ValueError("The diffusion pipeline does not support component-level model CPU offload.")
45	        enable_model_cpu_offload(device=resolved_device)

76	        width = (

1	# SVDQuant (Experimental)
2	
3	SVDQuant splits a linear weight into a quantized residual branch and a small
4	floating-point low-rank branch:
5	
6	```text
7	W ~= Q(R) + U @ V
8	Linear(x) ~= QuantizedLinear(x, Q(R)) + Linear(Linear(x, V), U)
9	```
10	
11	This feature follows the decomposition proposed in [SVDQuant: Absorbing
12	Outliers by Low-Rank Components for 4-Bit Diffusion
13	Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.05007). AutoRound can combine the transform
14	with RTN or SignRound and export a Nunchaku-loadable MXFP4 FLUX pipeline.
15	
16	> The end-to-end export path has been validated with FLUX.1-dev only. Other
17	> models using compatible Diffusers FLUX block classes are experimental and
18	> produce a warning.
19	
20	## Quick start
21	
22	Install AutoRound and its diffusion dependencies in an isolated environment:
23	
24	```bash
25	pip install --no-build-isolation -e .
26	pip install -r test/test_cuda/requirements_diffusion.txt
27	```
28	
29	### Default RTN workflow
30	
31	The recommended starting point uses rank 32, one residual iteration, no
32	smooth search, and plain RTN:
33	
34	```bash
35	CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 auto-round-rtn \
36	  --model /path/to/FLUX.1-dev \
37	  --model_dtype bf16 \
38	  --scheme MXFP4 \
39	  --algorithm svdquant \
40	  --format svdquant_nunchaku \
41	  --device 0 \
42	  --output_dir ./flux-dev-mxfp4-svdquant-rtn
43	```
44	
45	When `svdquant` is selected and `--format` is omitted, the CLI also defaults to
46	`svdquant_nunchaku`.
47	
48	### Default SignRound workflow
49	
50	Use SignRound as the terminal quantizer by selecting `auto_round`:
51	
52	```bash
53	CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 auto-round \
54	  --model /path/to/FLUX.1-dev \
55	  --model_dtype bf16 \
56	  --scheme MXFP4 \
57	  --algorithm svdquant,auto_round \
58	  --format svdquant_nunchaku \
59	  --dataset /path/to/coco2017-captions.tsv \
60	  --batch_size 1 \
61	  --device 0 \
62	  --low_gpu_mem_usage \
63	  --output_dir ./flux-dev-mxfp4-svdquant-signround
64	```
65	
66	The caption dataset is a tab-separated file with `id` and `caption` columns:
67	
68	```text
69	id	caption
70	0	A photo of a cat
71	1	A city street at night
72	```
73	
74	The COCO2017 calibration captions are available from
75	[`changwangss/coco2017`](https://huggingface.co/datasets/changwangss/coco2017).
76	
77	### Optional quality settings
78	
79	Smooth search and additional residual iterations are opt-in:
80	
81	```bash
82	--enable-svdquant-smooth \
83	--svdquant-smooth-num-grids 20 \
84	--svdquant-smooth-max-calibration-calls 128 \
85	--svdquant-residual-iters 20 \
86	--enable-svdquant-residual-early-stop
87	```
88	
89	For diffusion calibration, `--nsamples` controls prompts and
90	`--num_inference_steps` controls denoising steps. Start small before running a
91	full quality configuration.
92	
93	## Processing flow
94	
95	SVDQuant is a structural preprocessor and must run before one terminal
96	quantizer:
97	
98	```text
99	Original linear weights
100	  -> optional activation-aware smooth search
101	  -> group related projections
102	  -> low-rank decomposition and residual iteration
103	  -> replace nn.Linear with SVDQuantLinear
104	       -> quantized residual_linear
105	       -> floating-point lora_down
106	       -> floating-point lora_up
107	       -> optional input smooth factor
108	  -> RTN or SignRound
109	  -> Nunchaku export
110	```
111	
112	FLUX Q/K/V projections are grouped so they share one low-rank down factor and
113	retain separate up factors, matching the runtime layout.
114	
115	## Residual iteration
116	
117	With the default `residual_iters=1`:
118	
119	1. Compute a rank-limited decomposition of the grouped weight `W`.
120	2. Materialize `U` and `V` in `low_rank_dtype`.
121	3. Form `R = W - U @ V`.
122	4. Let the terminal RTN or SignRound stage quantize the residual linear.
123	
124	With `residual_iters > 1`, each outer iteration alternates between fitting the
125	low-rank branch to `W - Q(R_previous)` and applying deployment-compatible RTN
126	QDQ to the new residual. Early stop retains the best candidate and stops when
127	the objective becomes worse.
128	
129	The objective is weight reconstruction error without smooth search and
130	calibration output error with smooth search. Residual iterations are separate
131	from SignRound `--iters`.
132	
133	## Smooth search
134	
135	For `G = --svdquant-smooth-num-grids`, the candidates are:
136	
137	```text
138	(alpha, beta) = (0, 0)
139	(alpha, 0) for alpha in {1/G, ..., (G-1)/G}
140	(alpha, 1-alpha) for the same alpha values
141	```
142	
143	The default `G=20` produces 39 candidates. Each candidate constructs
144	`x_span**alpha / w_span**beta` and is scored against floating-point group
145	outputs. The lowest finite output error wins.
146	
147	`--svdquant-smooth-max-calibration-calls` uses reservoir sampling to bound the
148	retained calls per group. Calls that are not selected are not copied into the
149	smooth CPU cache. This limit does not replace SignRound calibration samples.
150	
151	## Configuration
152	
153	| Python field | CLI option | Default | Meaning |
154	|---|---|---:|---|
155	| `rank` | `--svdquant-rank` | `32` | Low-rank branch rank. |
156	| `smooth_enabled` | `--enable-svdquant-smooth` | `False` | Enable Alpha/Beta search. |
157	| `smooth_num_grids` | `--svdquant-smooth-num-grids` | `20` | Candidate grid resolution. |
158	| `smooth_max_calibration_calls` | `--svdquant-smooth-max-calibration-calls` | `128` | Retained calls per group. |
159	| `residual_iters` | `--svdquant-residual-iters` | `1` | Residual outer iterations. |
160	| `residual_early_stop` | `--enable-svdquant-residual-early-stop` | `False` | Stop after the objective worsens. |
161	| `low_rank_dtype` | `--svdquant-low-rank-dtype` | `bf16` | BF16, FP16, or FP32 factors. |
162	| `target_modules` | `--svdquant-target-modules` | `None` | Included module-name substrings. |
163	| `exclude_modules` | `--svdquant-exclude-modules` | `None` | Excluded module-name substrings. |
164	| `model_adapter` | `--svdquant-model-adapter` | `auto` | Runtime grouping/export adapter. |
165	
166	## Python API
167	
168	```python
169	from auto_round import AutoRound
170	from auto_round.algorithms.quantization.rtn.config import RTNConfig
171	from auto_round.algorithms.transforms.svdquant import SVDQuantConfig
172	
173	autoround = AutoRound(
174	    "/path/to/FLUX.1-dev",
175	    scheme="MXFP4",
176	    model_dtype="bf16",
177	    alg_configs=[
178	        SVDQuantConfig(rank=32, model_adapter="flux"),
179	        RTNConfig(disable_opt_rtn=True),
180	    ],
181	    device_map=0,
182	    low_gpu_mem_usage=True,
183	)
184	autoround.quantize_and_save(
185	    "./flux-dev-mxfp4-svdquant-rtn",
186	    format="svdquant_nunchaku",
187	)
188	```
189	
190	## Export and inference
191	
192	The `svdquant_nunchaku` format currently requires MXFP4 E2M1 W4A4, group size
193	32, symmetric weights/activations, dynamic activation quantization, and a
194	supported runtime adapter. Nunchaku is not imported during quantization; it is
195	required only for inference.
196	
197	Pre-quantized FLUX.1-dev checkpoints are available for
198	[smooth SVDQuant + SignRound](https://huggingface.co/changwangss/smooth_svdquant_signround)
199	and
200	[no-smooth SVDQuant + SignRound](https://huggingface.co/changwangss/nosmooth_svdquant_signround).
201	
202	The output is a self-contained Diffusers pipeline. Load its Nunchaku transformer
203	explicitly, then pass it to Diffusers:
204	
205	```python
206	import torch
207	from diffusers import FluxPipeline
208	from nunchaku import NunchakuFluxTransformer2dModel
209	
210	model_dir = "./flux-dev-mxfp4-svdquant-signround"
211	transformer = NunchakuFluxTransformer2dModel.from_pretrained(
212	    f"{model_dir}/transformer/diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors",
213	    torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
214	    precision="mxfp4",
215	    device="cuda:0",
216	)
217	pipe = FluxPipeline.from_pretrained(
218	    model_dir,
219	    transformer=transformer,
220	    torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
221	    local_files_only=True,
222	)
223	pipe.enable_model_cpu_offload()
224	
225	image = pipe(
226	    "A cat holding a sign that says Hello world",
227	    num_inference_steps=20,
228	    guidance_scale=3.5,
229	    generator=torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(12345),
230	    height=512,
231	    width=512,
232	).images[0]
233	image.save("flux-svdquant-mxfp4.png")
234	```
235	
236	## Limitations
237	
238	- Runtime-loadable export is currently validated only for FLUX.1-dev.
239	- SVDQuant requires `nblocks=1`.
240	- Smooth search replays every retained call for every Alpha/Beta candidate.
241	- More residual iterations repeat decomposition and QDQ work.
242	- A smoke image validates loading and numerical stability, not dataset-level
243	  generation quality.

# 一、Diffusion 量化入口与路由

## 1.1 入口类

- 真正的路由：`AutoRound.__new__` → `_build_model_type_ctor_kwargs`（`autoround.py:236-249`）调用 `detect_model_type(model)`（`auto_round/utils/model.py:1337-1355`），`is_diffusion_model` 优先判定（`utils/model.py:1346-1348`）。
- `is_diffusion_model`（`utils/model.py:1290-1334`）判定依据：
  - `model_type == "nextstep"` 特例（`utils/model.py:1307-1309`）；
  - 存在 `model_index.json`（HF repo 或本地目录，`utils/model.py:1314-1328`）；
  - 或实例是 `diffusers.pipeline_utils.DiffusionPipeline`（`utils/model.py:1329-1332`）。
- 路由到 compressor：`_get_compressor_class`（`autoround.py:116-141`）对 `model_type == "diffusion"` 动态拼出 `Diffusion{BaseCls} = (DiffusionMixin, BaseCls)`（`autoround.py:133-139`）。**没有独立的 DiffusionCompressor 类**，行为由 `auto_round/compressors/diffusion_mixin.py:33` 的 `DiffusionMixin` 注入；校准策略由 `DiffusionCalibrator`（`auto_round/calibration/diffusion.py:51-52`，`@register_calibrator("diffusion")`，mixin 通过 `_get_calibrator_kind` 返回 `"diffusion"`，`diffusion_mixin.py:140-148`）承担。
- `auto_round/compressors/diffusion/` 目录下只有 `dataset.py`（校准数据）、`eval.py`（评估）、`README.md`，无 compressor 文件。

## 1.2 模型加载（pipeline 构建）

`diffusion_load_model`（`auto_round/utils/model.py:868-996`）：
- 仅支持 `platform="hf"`（`utils/model.py:885-888`）；
- `model_type=="nextstep"` → `load_next_step_diffusion`（`utils/model.py:902-908`；实现在 `special_model_handler.py:1228-1263`，用模型自带 `NextStepPipeline`）；
- `model_index.json` 的 `_class_name` ∈ `{"Cosmos3OmniDiffusersPipeline","Cosmos3OmniPipeline"}` → `load_cosmos3_diffusion`（`utils/model.py:918-922`；实现在 `special_model_handler.py:1417`）；
- 其余一律 `DiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained(path, torch_dtype=...)`（`utils/model.py:939-941`）；
- **量化目标子模块**：有 `pipe.unet` 取 unet（SD/SDXL，`utils/model.py:959-961`），否则取 `pipe.transformer`（DiT 系，如 Flux、SD3，`utils/model.py:962-964`）。text encoder（T5/CLIP）**不量化**，仅在 `_align_pipeline_dtype` 里对齐 dtype（`diffusion_mixin.py:126-138`），保存时走 `val.save_pretrained`（`diffusion_mixin.py:592-594`）。

## 1.3 CLI diffusion 参数组

- 校准流程（`calibration/diffusion.py:98-213`）：逐条 prompt 真跑 pipeline 推理（**确实生成图像/去噪**，hooks 捕获每个 denoising step 的 block 输入；`nsamples * num_inference_steps` 次前向，警告见 `calibration/diffusion.py:112-115`）；`generator_seed` 固定初始噪声（`calibration/diffusion.py:155-159`）；I2V pipeline 自动合成灰色占位图（`calibration/diffusion.py:71-96, 160-168`）；NextStep/StableAudio 走 `_autoround_pipeline_fn` 自定义调用（`calibration/diffusion.py:169-176`）；双 transformer（Wan）时 `num_inference_steps<2` 强制提到 2（`diffusion_mixin.py:400-407`）；batch_size≠1 强制重置为 1 并放大 gradient_accumulate_steps（`diffusion_mixin.py:86-113`）。

# 五、Diffusion 支持的 scheme / format / 加载方

- scheme：无 diffusion 专属限制；README 示例用 `MXFP8`（`README.md:23-29`），测试用 `MXFP4`（`test/unit/test_cuda/models/test_diffusion.py:43,88`），W4A16 等 int 方案理论可用（通用 scheme 校验）。SVDQuant 路线固定 MXFP4。
- format：
  - `fake`：`FakeFormat`（`export/formats/backends/fake.py:36-39`）——README 明说"Loading quantized diffusion models is not supported yet, so use fake format"（`README.md:12,34-35`），即 QDQ 假量化权重留在模型里，按组件 `save_pretrained` 保存（`diffusion_mixin.py:503-613`），**导出后没有官方加载方**（评估时直接把内存里的量化 transformer 塞回 pipe，`eval/evaluation.py:139-147`）。
  - `svdquant_nunchaku`：FLUX + MXFP4，加载方为 **nunchaku + diffusers**（见 3.3）。
  - Cosmos3 特例导出对齐 vllm-omni（`special_model_handler.py:1376,1448`）。
- 多 transformer 保存：每个 transformer 组件写各自子目录（`diffusion_mixin.py:541-599`），权重文件重命名 `diffusion_pytorch_model*`（`diffusion_mixin.py:596-597`，`utils/model.py:2527-2528`），`model_index.json` 手工/经 config 写出（`diffusion_mixin.py:601-609`）。

# 六、VLM（DeepSeek-OCR-2）能否走 MLLM 文本量化路径

- 路由：vision+text 因果 LM 会被 `is_mllm_model` 识别（依据 `preprocessor_config.json`/`processor_config.json`/config 键含 `MM_KEYS`，`utils/model.py:1222-1274`）→ `model_type="mllm"` → `MLLMMixin`（`autoround.py:129-132`）。默认 `quant_nontext_module=False`（`mllm_mixin.py:54`），只量化文本块；template 未注册时 fallback 到 `TEMPLATES["default"]`（`template.py:185-188`）。
- **注册表现状（DeepSeek-OCR-2 无专属项）**：
  - `SUPPORT_ONLY_TEXT_MODELS`（`special_model_handler.py:36-56`）：含 `deepseek_vl_v2`，**没有** deepseek_ocr / deepseek_ocr2。注意该列表在 `auto_round/` 内除定义处外**无任何消费方**（grep 全库仅 `NOT_SUPPORT_ONLY_TEXT_MODELS` 被 `calibration/mllm.py:55,104` 使用），属于对外/遗留常量。
  - `SPECIAL_MULTIMODAL_BLOCK`（`special_model_handler.py:591-599`）：`deepseek_vl_v2 / qwen2_5_omni / qwen3_omni_moe / glm_image / mimo_audio / qwen3_tts / bagel`（另有 `cosmos3_vllm_omni` 追加于 `special_model_handler.py:1577`）——**没有** deepseek_ocr 相关项。
  - `ARCHITECTURE_MODEL_TYPE_MAP`（`utils/model.py:42-45`）只有 MiMoAudio 映射；MLLM templates（`template.py:120-132` + `compressors/mllm/templates/` 下 `cogvlm2/default/llava/phi3_v.json`）**没有** deepseek_ocr 模板。
- 但 **GGUF 导出转换显式支持 DeepSeek-OCR-2**：`DeepseekOCR2ForCausalLM` 注册于 `export/export_to_gguf/conversion/deepseek.py:109-116`（example `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-OCR-2`），架构→模块映射在 `conversion/__init__.py:277`，vision tower 作为 mmproj 导出（`deepseek.py:111-116`）。
- 结论：DeepSeek-OCR-2 走 MLLM 文本量化**没有专门适配**——会落到通用 MLLM 路径（默认 template + 仅文本块量化，前提是其 processor/tokenizer 与默认处理器兼容），代码中无 deepseek_ocr 的特例处理；官方明确的 OCR 支持仅体现在 GGUF 导出转换层。

# 七、Z-Image 痕迹

- 文档：`compressors/diffusion/README.md:66-67`（支持矩阵列 `Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image`、`Z-Image-Turb`，校准数据 COCO2014）。
- 测试：`test/fixtures.py:153-179`（`tiny_z_image_model_path` fixture，基于 `Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image` 裁剪）、`test/unit/test_cuda/models/test_diffusion.py:52-61`（`test_z_image_tune`，`AutoRound(tiny_z_image, iters=1, nsamples=1, num_inference_steps=2, dataset="coco2014")`）。
- **无任何 z_image/zimage 专用源码**（`auto_round/` 下 grep 0 命中）：无专用加载器、无 model_type 特例、无 pipeline_fn 特判。它走的是通用 `DiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained` + `pipe.transformer` 量化路径（`utils/model.py:939-964`）。

# 附：关键限制（代码/文档明示）

- 仅量化 transformer/unet，text encoder/VAE 不动（`README.md:11`；`utils/model.py:959-964`）。
- 量化后的 diffusion 模型（fake 格式）不支持重新加载（`README.md:12`；`eval/evaluation.py:140-144`）。
- SVDQuant 端到端导出仅验证 FLUX.1-dev（`docs/svdquant_details.md:16-18, 238`），`svdquant_nunchaku` 格式要求 nblocks=1（`docs/svdquant_details.md:239`）。
- diffusion 平台仅支持 HF（`utils/model.py:885-888`）。

1	# AutoRound for Diffusion Models (Experimental)
2	
3	This feature is experimental and may be subject to changes, including potential bug fixes, API modifications, or adjustments to default parameters.
4	
5	AutoRound uses the new compressor and calibration architecture for diffusion quantization. Diffusion models are routed by `auto_round/compressors/entry.py`, diffusion-specific compressor behavior lives in `auto_round/compressors/diffusion_mixin.py`, and calibration is handled by `auto_round/calibration/diffusion.py`.
6	
7	## Quantization
8	
9	Quantization for diffusion models is limited:
10	
11	1. Only the transformer module of diffusion models is quantized.
12	2. Loading quantized diffusion models is not supported yet, so use `fake` format for quantization.
13	3. Calibration dataset currently supports `coco2014` and user customized `.tsv` files.
14	
15	### API Usage (CPU/GPU) Recommended
16	
17	```python
18	import torch
19	from auto_round import AutoRound
20	
21	# Quantize the model
22	autoround = AutoRound(
23	    "black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-dev",
24	    scheme="MXFP8",
25	    dataset="coco2014",
26	    num_inference_steps=10,
27	    guidance_scale=7.5,
28	    generator_seed=None,
29	    batch_size=1,
30	)
31	
32	# Save the quantized model
33	output_dir = "./tmp_autoround"
34	# Loading quantized diffusion models is not supported yet, so use fake format.
35	autoround.quantize_and_save(output_dir, format="fake", inplace=True)
36	```
37	
38	- `dataset`: the dataset for quantization training. Currently supports `coco2014` and user customized `.tsv` files.
39	- `num_inference_steps`: the reference number of denoising steps.
40	- `guidance_scale`: controls how much the image generation process follows the text prompt.
41	- `generator_seed`: a seed that controls the initial noise from which an image is generated.
42	
43	For more hyperparameters, refer to [Homepage Detailed Hyperparameters](../../../README.md#quantization-scheme--configuration).
44	
45	### CLI Usage
46	
47	A user guide detailing the full list of supported arguments is provided by calling `auto-round -h` on the terminal.
48	
49	```bash
50	auto-round \
51	    --model black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-dev \
52	    --scheme MXFP8 \
53	    --format fake \
54	    --batch_size 1 \
55	    --dataset coco2014 \
56	    --output_dir ./tmp_autoround
57	```
58	
59	### Diffusion Support Matrix
60	
61	For diffusion models, currently we validate quantization on the following models, which involves quantizing the transformer component of the pipeline.
62	
63	| Model         | calibration dataset |  Model Link  |
64	|---------------|---------------------|--------------|
65	| black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-dev  | COCO2014      | - |
66	| Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image            | COCO2014      | - |
67	| Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image-Turb       | COCO2014      | - |
68	| stepfun-ai/NextStep-1.1       | COCO2014      | - |
69	| AIDC-AI/Ovis-Image-7B         | COCO2014      | - |
70	| stabilityai/stable-audio-open-1.0 | audiocaps | - |
71	| Wan-AI/Wan2.2-I2V-A14B-Diffusers | COCO2014   | - |
72	| Wan-AI/Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-Diffusers  | COCO2014   | - |

74	| nvidia/Cosmos3-Nano              | COCO2014   | - |

78	<summary style="font-size:17px;">Calibration Dataset</summary>
79

33	class DiffusionMixin:
34	    """Diffusion-specific functionality mixin.
35	
36	    This mixin adds diffusion model-specific functionality to any compressor
37	    (Compressor, ImatrixCompressor, etc). It handles
38	    diffusion models (like Stable Diffusion, FLUX) that require special pipeline
39	    handling and data generation logic.
40	
41	    Can be combined with:
42	    - Compressor (for AutoRound with calibration, or basic RTN)
43	    - ImatrixCompressor (for RTN with importance matrix)
44	
45	    Diffusion-specific parameters:
46	        guidance_scale: Control how much image generation follows text prompt
47	        num_inference_steps: Reference number of denoising steps
48	        generator_seed: Seed for initial noise generation
49	
50	    Design note:
51	        ``ModelContext._load_model()`` loads the diffusion pipeline and sets
52	        ``model_context.pipe`` and ``model_context.model`` (the unet/transformer).
53	        This mixin reads ``self.model_context.pipe`` directly during calibration and
54	        saving so that ``model_context`` remains the single source of truth.
55	    """
56	
57	    def __init__(
58	        self,
59	        *args,
60	        guidance_scale: float = 7.5,
61	        num_inference_steps: int = 50,
62	        generator_seed: Optional[int] = None,
63	        **kwargs,
64	    ) -> None:
65	        # Store diffusion-specific attributes
66	        self.guidance_scale = guidance_scale
67	        self.num_inference_steps = num_inference_steps
68	        self.generator_seed = generator_seed
69	        self.pipeline_call_kwargs = dict(kwargs.pop("pipeline_call_kwargs", {}) or {})
70	
71	        # Default dataset for diffusion models is "coco2014", not "NeelNanda/pile-10k"
72	        if kwargs.get("dataset") in (None, "NeelNanda/pile-10k"):
73	            kwargs["dataset"] = "coco2014"
74	
75	        iters = kwargs.get("iters", None)
76	        _alg_cfg = args[0] if args else None
77	        if iters is None and _alg_cfg is not None:
78	            cfgs = _alg_cfg if isinstance(_alg_cfg, list) else [_alg_cfg]
79	            for cfg in cfgs:
80	                if hasattr(cfg, "iters") and cfg.iters is not None:
81	                    iters = cfg.iters
82	                    break
83	        if iters is None:
84	            iters = 200
85	
86	        if iters > 0:
87	            # ``batch_size`` is owned by the compressor / shared
88	            # CalibrationContext; it only comes from kwargs now (entry.py forwards
89	            # it explicitly).  AlgConfig no longer carries it.  Treat a missing
90	            # value as ``BaseCompressor``'s default (8) so the reset path always
91	            # triggers when the user didn't explicitly opt out.
92	            batch_size = kwargs.get("batch_size", 8)
93	            if batch_size != 1:
94	                grad_acc = kwargs.get("gradient_accumulate_steps", 1)
95	                if _alg_cfg is not None:
96	                    cfgs = _alg_cfg if isinstance(_alg_cfg, list) else [_alg_cfg]
97	                    for cfg in cfgs:
98	                        if hasattr(cfg, "gradient_accumulate_steps") and cfg.gradient_accumulate_steps is not None:
99	                            grad_acc = cfg.gradient_accumulate_steps
100	                            break
101	                new_grad_acc = batch_size * grad_acc
102	                kwargs["gradient_accumulate_steps"] = new_grad_acc
103	                kwargs["batch_size"] = 1
104	                if _alg_cfg is not None:
105	                    cfgs = _alg_cfg if isinstance(_alg_cfg, list) else [_alg_cfg]
106	                    for cfg in cfgs:
107	                        if hasattr(cfg, "gradient_accumulate_steps"):
108	                            cfg.gradient_accumulate_steps = new_grad_acc
109	                logger.warning(
110	                    f"reset batch_size({batch_size}) to 1 and "
111	                    f"gradient_accumulate_steps to {new_grad_acc} "
112	                    f"because batch_size={batch_size} cannot be used for calibrating non-text modules."
113	                )
114	
115	        # Call parent class __init__ (will be Compressor, ImatrixCompressor, etc)
116	        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
117	
118	        pipe = getattr(self.model_context, "pipe", None)
119	        model = getattr(self.model_context, "model", None)
120	        if pipe is not None and model is not None:
121	            is_nextstep = hasattr(model, "config") and getattr(model.config, "model_type", None) == "nextstep"
122	            if not is_nextstep:
123	                self._align_pipeline_dtype(pipe, model.dtype)

127	        """Align ordinary components while preserving declared FP32 modules."""
128	        for component_name in pipe.components:

132	                or not hasattr(component, "dtype")
133	                or component.dtype == target_dtype

136	def get_diffusion_dataloader(dataset="coco2014", bs=1, seed=42, nsamples=128):
137	    """Generate a DataLoader for calibration using specified parameters.
138	    Args:
139	        Dataset_name (str): The name or path of the dataset.
140	        bs (int, optional): The batch size. Defaults to 1.
141	    Returns:
142	        DataLoader: The DataLoader for the calibrated datasets.
143	    """
144	    if dataset in COCO_URL:
145	        import requests
146	
147	        logger.info(f"use dataset {dataset}, downloading ...")
148	        response = requests.get(COCO_URL[dataset], timeout=30)
149	        response.raise_for_status()
150	        dataframe = pd.read_csv(StringIO(response.text), sep="\t")
151	        dataset = DIFFUSION_DATASET["local"](dataset, nsamples, dataframe=dataframe)
152	
153	    if dataset in ("audiocaps",):
154	        dataset = download_audiocaps_csv()
155	
156	    if isinstance(dataset, Dataset):
157	        pass
158	    elif isinstance(dataset, str) and os.path.exists(dataset):
159	        if dataset.endswith(".csv"):
160	            dataset = DIFFUSION_DATASET["audiocaps"](dataset, nsamples)
161	        else:
162	            dataset = DIFFUSION_DATASET["local"](dataset, nsamples)
163	    else:
164	        raise ValueError("Only support coco2014/audiocaps dataset or loading local tsv/csv file now.")
165	    set_seed(seed)
166	    dataloader_params = {"batch_size": bs, "shuffle": True}
167	
168	    return DataLoader(dataset, **dataloader_params), bs

30	def compute_clip(prompts, images, device: str = "cuda"):
31	    clip_model = metrics.CLIPScore(model_name_or_path="openai/clip-vit-large-patch14").to(device)
32	    for prompt, img_path in tqdm(zip(prompts, images), desc="Computing CLIP score"):
33	        image_data = Image.open(img_path).convert("RGB")
34	        image_tensor = torch.from_numpy(np.array(image_data)).permute(2, 0, 1)
35	        clip_model.update(image_tensor.to(torch.float32).to(device).unsqueeze(0), prompt)
36	    result = clip_model.compute().mean().item()
37	    return {"CLIP": result}

66	def diffusion_eval(
67	    pipe,
68	    prompt_file,
69	    metrics,
70	    image_save_dir,
71	    batch_size,
72	    gen_kwargs,
73	    limit=None,
74	):
75	    if (
76	        not importlib.util.find_spec("clip")
77	        or not importlib.util.find_spec("ImageReward")
78	        or not importlib.util.find_spec("torchmetrics")
79	    ):
80	        raise ImportError(
81	            "Please make sure clip, image-reward and torchmetrics are installed for diffusion model evaluation."
82	        )
83	    dataloader, _, _ = get_diffusion_dataloader(prompt_file, nsamples=-1, bs=batch_size)
84	    prompt_list = []
85	    image_list = []
86	    num_samples = 0
87	    for image_ids, prompts in dataloader:
88	        prompt_list.extend(prompts)
89	
90	        new_ids = []
91	        new_prompts = []
92	        for idx, image_id in enumerate(image_ids):
93	            image_id = image_id.item()
94	            image_list.append(os.path.join(image_save_dir, str(image_id) + ".png"))
95	
96	            if os.path.exists(os.path.join(image_save_dir, str(image_id) + ".png")):
97	                continue
98	            new_ids.append(image_id)
99	            new_prompts.append(prompts[idx])
100	            num_samples += 1
101	            if limit is not None and num_samples >= limit > 0:
102	                break
103	
104	        if len(new_prompts) == 0:
105	            continue
106	
107	        output = pipe(prompt=new_prompts, **gen_kwargs)
108	        for idx, image_id in enumerate(new_ids):
109	            output.images[idx].save(os.path.join(image_save_dir, str(image_id) + ".png"))
110	
111	        if limit is not None and num_samples >= limit > 0:
112	            break
113	
114	    result = {}
115	    for metric in metrics:
116	        result.update(metric_map[metric](prompt_list, image_list, pipe.device))

14	"""Diffusion calibration strategy.
15	
16	Inherits :class:`LLMCalibrator` for ``collect`` / ``cache_inter_data``,
17	and customises:
18	
19	- :meth:`calib` — drive the diffusion ``pipe`` with prompts / inference steps.
20	- :meth:`should_stop` — always ``False`` so all denoising steps execute.
21	- :meth:`wrap_block_forward` — convert positional → kwargs for diffusion blocks.
22	"""
23	
24	import inspect
25	from typing import Optional
26	
27	import torch
28	from tqdm import tqdm
29	
30	from auto_round.calibration.llm import LLMCalibrator
31	from auto_round.calibration.register import register_calibrator
32	from auto_round.compressors import BaseOrchestrator as BaseCompressor
33	from auto_round.logger import logger
34	from auto_round.utils.device_manager import device_manager
35	from auto_round.utils.model import wrap_block_forward_positional_to_kwargs
36	
37	
38	def _prepare_pipeline_for_calibration(pipe, target_device, *, low_gpu_mem_usage: bool) -> str | None:
39	    """Place a diffusion pipeline for calibration without exceeding one GPU."""
40	    resolved_device = torch.device(target_device)
41	    if low_gpu_mem_usage:
42	        enable_model_cpu_offload = getattr(pipe, "enable_model_cpu_offload", None)
43	        if not callable(enable_model_cpu_offload):
44	            raise ValueError("The diffusion pipeline does not support component-level model CPU offload.")
45	        enable_model_cpu_offload(device=resolved_device)
46	        return "model"
47	    pipe.to(resolved_device)
48	    return None
49	
50	
51	@register_calibrator("diffusion")
52	class DiffusionCalibrator(LLMCalibrator):
53	    """Calibrator for diffusion models (Stable Diffusion / FLUX / ...)."""
54	
55	    # ── Overrides for diffusion-specific behaviour ─────────────────────────
56	    def __init__(self, compressor: BaseCompressor):
57	        super().__init__(compressor)
58	        self.pipe = compressor.pipe
59	        self.guidance_scale = compressor.guidance_scale
60	        self.num_inference_steps = compressor.num_inference_steps
61	        self.generator_seed = compressor.generator_seed  # make sure pass
62	
63	    def _wrap_block_forward(self, forward_fn):
64	        """Wrap positional-arg block forward into kwargs form for diffusion blocks."""
65	        return wrap_block_forward_positional_to_kwargs(forward_fn)
66	
67	    def _should_stop_cache_forward(self, name: str) -> bool:
68	        """Diffusion calibration never early-stops: all denoising steps execute."""
69	        return False
70	
71	    def _get_calibration_image(self, batch_size: int):
72	        """Return a synthetic PIL Image for I2V pipeline calibration."""
73	        params = inspect.signature(self.pipe.__call__).parameters
74	        width_param = params.get("width")
75	        height_param = params.get("height")
76	        width = (
77	            832
78	            if width_param is None or width_param.default in (inspect.Parameter.empty, None)
79	            else width_param.default
80	        )
81	        height = (
82	            480
83	            if height_param is None or height_param.default in (inspect.Parameter.empty, None)
84	            else height_param.default
85	        )
86	        from PIL import Image  # pylint: disable=E0401
87	
88	        image = Image.new("RGB", (int(width), int(height)), color=(127, 127, 127))
89	        if batch_size == 1:
90	            return image
91	        return [image.copy() for _ in range(batch_size)]
92	
93	    def _requires_calibration_image(self) -> bool:
94	        """Return whether the pipeline requires an image input."""
95	        image_param = inspect.signature(self.pipe.__call__).parameters.get("image")
96	        return image_param is not None and image_param.default is inspect.Parameter.empty
97	
98	    @torch.no_grad()
99	    def calib(self, nsamples: int, bs: int) -> None:
100	        """Drive the diffusion pipeline so block-forward hooks fire.
101	
102	        Verbatim port of the legacy ``DiffusionMixin.calib``.
103	        """
104	        from auto_round.compressors.diffusion.dataset import get_diffusion_dataloader
105	
106	        pipe = self.pipe
107	        if pipe is None:
108	            raise ValueError(
109	                "Diffusion pipeline not found in model_context. " "Ensure the model was loaded as a diffusion model."
110	            )
111	
112	        logger.warning(
113	            "Diffusion model will catch nsamples * num_inference_steps inputs, "
114	            "you can reduce nsamples or num_inference_steps if OOM or take too much time."
115	        )
116	        if isinstance(self.dataset, str):
117	            dataset = self.dataset.replace(" ", "")
118	            self.dataloader, self.batch_size = get_diffusion_dataloader(
119	                dataset=dataset, bs=bs, seed=self.seed, nsamples=nsamples
120	            )
121	        else:
122	            self.dataloader = self.dataset
123	        total_cnt = 0
124	
125	        total = nsamples if not hasattr(self.dataloader, "len") else min(nsamples, len(self.dataloader))
126	
127	        if (
128	            hasattr(self.model, "hf_device_map")
129	            and len(self.model.hf_device_map) > 1
130	            and pipe.device != self.model.device
131	            and torch.device(self.model.device).type in ["cuda", "xpu"]
132	        ):
133	            logger.error(
134	                "Diffusion model is activated sequential model offloading, it will crash during moving to GPU/XPU. "
135	                "Please use model path for quantization or "
136	                "move the pipeline object to GPU/XPU before passing them into API."
137	            )
138	            exit(-1)
139	
140	        target_device = device_manager.device
141	        self._cpu_offload_mode = _prepare_pipeline_for_calibration(
142	            pipe,
143	            target_device,
144	            low_gpu_mem_usage=self.low_gpu_mem_usage,
145	        )
146	        pipeline_fn = getattr(pipe, "_autoround_pipeline_fn", None)
147	        # Check if this is an I2V pipeline (needs calibration image)
148	        requires_image = self._requires_calibration_image()
149	
150	        with tqdm(range(1, total + 1), desc="cache block inputs") as pbar:
151	            for ids, prompts in self.dataloader:
152	                if isinstance(prompts, tuple):
153	                    prompts = list(prompts)
154	                try:
155	                    generator = (
156	                        None
157	                        if self.generator_seed is None
158	                        else torch.Generator(device=pipe.device).manual_seed(self.generator_seed)
159	                    )
160	                    if requires_image:
161	                        image = self._get_calibration_image(len(prompts) if isinstance(prompts, list) else 1)
162	                        pipe(
163	                            image,
164	                            prompt=prompts,
165	                            guidance_scale=self.guidance_scale,
166	                            num_inference_steps=self.num_inference_steps,
167	                            generator=generator,
168	                        )
169	                    elif pipeline_fn is not None:
170	                        pipeline_fn(
171	                            pipe,
172	                            prompts,
173	                            guidance_scale=self.guidance_scale,
174	                            num_inference_steps=self.num_inference_steps,
175	                            generator=generator,
176	                        )
177	                    else:
178	                        pipe(
179	                            prompts,
180	                            guidance_scale=self.guidance_scale,
181	                            num_inference_steps=self.num_inference_steps,
182	                            generator=generator,
183	                        )
184	                except NotImplementedError:
185	                    pass
186	                except Exception as error:
187	                    raise error
188	                step = len(prompts)
189	                total_cnt += step
190	                pbar.update(step)
191	                if total_cnt >= nsamples:
192	                    break
193	        if total_cnt == 0:
194	            logger.error(
195	                f"no data has been cached, please provide more data with sequence length >={self.seqlen} in the "
196	                f"dataset or decease the sequence length"
197	            )
198	            exit(-1)
199	        elif total_cnt < nsamples:
200	            logger.warning(
201	                f"Insufficient number of samples collected may affect the quantization. "
202	                f"target samples count is {nsamples}, while valid samples count is {total_cnt}"
203	            )
204	            if total_cnt < self.batch_size:
205	                raise ValueError(
206	                    f"valid samples is less than batch_size({self.batch_size}),"
207	                    " please adjust c.batch_size or seqlen."
208	                )
209	            max_len = (total_cnt // self.batch_size) * self.batch_size
210	            for k, v in self.inputs.items():
211	                for key in v:
212	                    if isinstance(v[key], list) and len(v[key]) == total_cnt:
213	                        self.inputs[k][key] = v[key][:max_len]

74	def _normalize_gemma4_per_layer_input(positional_inputs, hidden_states):
75	    if positional_inputs is None or len(positional_inputs) == 0:
76	        return positional_inputs
77	
78	    per_layer_input = positional_inputs[0]
79	    if not isinstance(per_layer_input, torch.Tensor) or per_layer_input.shape[1] == hidden_states.shape[1]:
80	        return positional_inputs
81	
82	    hs_seq = hidden_states.shape[1]
83	    pl_seq = per_layer_input.shape[1]
84	    if hs_seq <= pl_seq:
85	        per_layer_input = per_layer_input[:, :hs_seq, :]
86	    else:
87	        pad = per_layer_input[:, -1:, :].expand(-1, hs_seq - pl_seq, -1)
88	        per_layer_input = torch.cat([per_layer_input, pad], dim=1)
89	
90	    normalized_inputs = list(positional_inputs)
91	    normalized_inputs[0] = per_layer_input

1	# SVDQuant (Experimental)
2	
3	SVDQuant splits a linear weight into a quantized residual branch and a small
4	floating-point low-rank branch:
5	
6	```text
7	W ~= Q(R) + U @ V
8	Linear(x) ~= QuantizedLinear(x, Q(R)) + Linear(Linear(x, V), U)
9	```
10	
11	This feature follows the decomposition proposed in [SVDQuant: Absorbing
12	Outliers by Low-Rank Components for 4-Bit Diffusion
13	Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.05007). AutoRound can combine the transform
14	with RTN or SignRound and export a Nunchaku-loadable MXFP4 FLUX pipeline.
15	
16	> The end-to-end export path has been validated with FLUX.1-dev only. Other
17	> models using compatible Diffusers FLUX block classes are experimental and
18	> produce a warning.
19	
20	## Quick start
21	
22	Install AutoRound and its diffusion dependencies in an isolated environment:
23	
24	```bash
25	pip install --no-build-isolation -e .
26	pip install -r test/test_cuda/requirements_diffusion.txt
27	```
28	
29	### Default RTN workflow
30	
31	The recommended starting point uses rank 32, one residual iteration, no
32	smooth search, and plain RTN:
33	
34	```bash
35	CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 auto-round-rtn \
36	  --model /path/to/FLUX.1-dev \
37	  --model_dtype bf16 \
38	  --scheme MXFP4 \
39	  --algorithm svdquant \
40	  --format svdquant_nunchaku \
41	  --device 0 \
42	  --output_dir ./flux-dev-mxfp4-svdquant-rtn
43	```
44	
45	When `svdquant` is selected and `--format` is omitted, the CLI also defaults to
46	`svdquant_nunchaku`.
47	
48	### Default SignRound workflow
49	
50	Use SignRound as the terminal quantizer by selecting `auto_round`:
51	
52	```bash
53	CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 auto-round \
54	  --model /path/to/FLUX.1-dev \
55	  --model_dtype bf16 \
56	  --scheme MXFP4 \
57	  --algorithm svdquant,auto_round \
58	  --format svdquant_nunchaku \
59	  --dataset /path/to/coco2017-captions.tsv \
60	  --batch_size 1 \
61	  --device 0 \
62	  --low_gpu_mem_usage \
63	  --output_dir ./flux-dev-mxfp4-svdquant-signround
64	```
65	
66	The caption dataset is a tab-separated file with `id` and `caption` columns:
67	
68	```text
69	id	caption
70	0	A photo of a cat
71	1	A city street at night
72	```
73	
74	The COCO2017 calibration captions are available from
75	[`changwangss/coco2017`](https://huggingface.co/datasets/changwangss/coco2017).
76	
77	### Optional quality settings
78	
79	Smooth search and additional residual iterations are opt-in:
80	
81	```bash
82	--enable-svdquant-smooth \
83	--svdquant-smooth-num-grids 20 \
84	--svdquant-smooth-max-calibration-calls 128 \
85	--svdquant-residual-iters 20 \
86	--enable-svdquant-residual-early-stop
87	```
88	
89	For diffusion calibration, `--nsamples` controls prompts and
90	`--num_inference_steps` controls denoising steps. Start small before running a
91	full quality configuration.
92	
93	## Processing flow
94	
95	SVDQuant is a structural preprocessor and must run before one terminal
96	quantizer:
97	
98	```text
99	Original linear weights
100	  -> optional activation-aware smooth search
101	  -> group related projections
102	  -> low-rank decomposition and residual iteration
103	  -> replace nn.Linear with SVDQuantLinear
104	       -> quantized residual_linear
105	       -> floating-point lora_down
106	       -> floating-point lora_up
107	       -> optional input smooth factor
108	  -> RTN or SignRound
109	  -> Nunchaku export
110	```
111	
112	FLUX Q/K/V projections are grouped so they share one low-rank down factor and
113	retain separate up factors, matching the runtime layout.
114	
115	## Residual iteration
116	
117	With the default `residual_iters=1`:
118	
119	1. Compute a rank-limited decomposition of the grouped weight `W`.
120	2. Materialize `U` and `V` in `low_rank_dtype`.
121	3. Form `R = W - U @ V`.
122	4. Let the terminal RTN or SignRound stage quantize the residual linear.
123	
124	With `residual_iters > 1`, each outer iteration alternates between fitting the
125	low-rank branch to `W - Q(R_previous)` and applying deployment-compatible RTN
126	QDQ to the new residual. Early stop retains the best candidate and stops when
127	the objective becomes worse.
128	
129	The objective is weight reconstruction error without smooth search and
130	calibration output error with smooth search. Residual iterations are separate
131	from SignRound `--iters`.
132	
133	## Smooth search
134	
135	For `G = --svdquant-smooth-num-grids`, the candidates are:
136	
137	```text
138	(alpha, beta) = (0, 0)
139	(alpha, 0) for alpha in {1/G, ..., (G-1)/G}
140	(alpha, 1-alpha) for the same alpha values
141	```
142	
143	The default `G=20` produces 39 candidates. Each candidate constructs
144	`x_span**alpha / w_span**beta` and is scored against floating-point group
145	outputs. The lowest finite output error wins.
146	
147	`--svdquant-smooth-max-calibration-calls` uses reservoir sampling to bound the
148	retained calls per group. Calls that are not selected are not copied into the
149	smooth CPU cache. This limit does not replace SignRound calibration samples.
150	
151	## Configuration
152	
153	| Python field | CLI option | Default | Meaning |
154	|---|---|---:|---|
155	| `rank` | `--svdquant-rank` | `32` | Low-rank branch rank. |
156	| `smooth_enabled` | `--enable-svdquant-smooth` | `False` | Enable Alpha/Beta search. |
157	| `smooth_num_grids` | `--svdquant-smooth-num-grids` | `20` | Candidate grid resolution. |
158	| `smooth_max_calibration_calls` | `--svdquant-smooth-max-calibration-calls` | `128` | Retained calls per group. |
159	| `residual_iters` | `--svdquant-residual-iters` | `1` | Residual outer iterations. |
160	| `residual_early_stop` | `--enable-svdquant-residual-early-stop` | `False` | Stop after the objective worsens. |
161	| `low_rank_dtype` | `--svdquant-low-rank-dtype` | `bf16` | BF16, FP16, or FP32 factors. |
162	| `target_modules` | `--svdquant-target-modules` | `None` | Included module-name substrings. |
163	| `exclude_modules` | `--svdquant-exclude-modules` | `None` | Excluded module-name substrings. |
164	| `model_adapter` | `--svdquant-model-adapter` | `auto` | Runtime grouping/export adapter. |
165	
166	## Python API
167	
168	```python
169	from auto_round import AutoRound
170	from auto_round.algorithms.quantization.rtn.config import RTNConfig
171	from auto_round.algorithms.transforms.svdquant import SVDQuantConfig
172	
173	autoround = AutoRound(
174	    "/path/to/FLUX.1-dev",
175	    scheme="MXFP4",
176	    model_dtype="bf16",
177	    alg_configs=[
178	        SVDQuantConfig(rank=32, model_adapter="flux"),
179	        RTNConfig(disable_opt_rtn=True),
180	    ],
181	    device_map=0,
182	    low_gpu_mem_usage=True,
183	)
184	autoround.quantize_and_save(
185	    "./flux-dev-mxfp4-svdquant-rtn",
186	    format="svdquant_nunchaku",
187	)
188	```
189	
190	## Export and inference
191	
192	The `svdquant_nunchaku` format currently requires MXFP4 E2M1 W4A4, group size
193	32, symmetric weights/activations, dynamic activation quantization, and a
194	supported runtime adapter. Nunchaku is not imported during quantization; it is
195	required only for inference.
196	
197	Pre-quantized FLUX.1-dev checkpoints are available for
198	[smooth SVDQuant + SignRound](https://huggingface.co/changwangss/smooth_svdquant_signround)
199	and
200	[no-smooth SVDQuant + SignRound](https://huggingface.co/changwangss/nosmooth_svdquant_signround).
201	
202	The output is a self-contained Diffusers pipeline. Load its Nunchaku transformer
203	explicitly, then pass it to Diffusers:

230	    height=512,

242	- A smoke image validates loading and numerical stability, not dataset-level
243	  generation quality.
